# SOP-P1-L4-04 Shift handover - Heat Treat line
Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-CN01, EQ-P1-L4-HP02, EQ-P1-L4-HT03  
Related: MM-P1-L4-CN01, QS-PROC-05, SB-1046

Purpose
1. Provide a concise, auditable handover procedure for shift changes on the Heat Treat line to ensure continuity, safety, and product quality.

Preconditions
2. Outgoing operator must complete the end-of-shift checklist and confirm all items documented in MM-P1-L4-CN01 are closed or flagged for follow-up.  
3. All critical alarms cleared and latched conditions logged per QS-PROC-05.

PPE
4. Mandatory: safety glasses, heat-resistant gloves, hearing protection, and steel-toe footwear. Additional PPE as required by SB-1046 when entering furnace areas.

Handover steps
5. Review process status: confirm furnace setpoints and active programs on EQ-P1-L4-HT03. The austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) is 880 °C.  
6. Verify CNC readiness: ensure the CNC control for EQ-P1-L4-CN01 shows no fault and spindle warm-up completed. The spindle warm-up time for Heat Treat CNC turning center #1 (EQ-P1-L4-CN01) is 15 minutes.  
7. Check hydraulic press EQ-P1-L4-HP02 for leak indication and pressure lamp status; report discrepancies. Refer to MM-P1-L4-CN01 for maintenance history.  
8. Confirm lot traceability: incoming material, heat numbers, and process batch IDs match the shift log. Any mismatches follow QS-PROC-05 nonconformance flow.  
9. Safety walkthrough: inspect access ways, emergency stop functionality, and furnace door interlocks. Note any findings in the shift log and tag equipment per SB-1046.

Documentation and communication
10. Outgoing operator completes electronic shift report, noting open actions and outstanding maintenance requests. Include references to MM-P1-L4-CN01 and QS-PROC-05 where applicable.

Sign-off
11. Both outgoing and incoming operators sign the handover record. Record operator IDs and timestamp in the system. Retain signed copy per SB-1046 retention requirements.
